# get_article

## Purpose

Read one article from its ID: its text, summary, author, type (`collab` or `personal`), categories, activities and quality, and the routes, waypoints, articles, outings and books associated with it, with their IDs.

## Inputs

<!-- generated:inputs start -->

<!-- Generated by npm run docs:tools from the registered input schema. Do not edit. -->

| Parameter | Type    | Required | Default | Constraints |
| --------- | ------- | -------- | ------- | ----------- |
| `id`      | integer | yes      |         | > 0         |
| `lang`    | string  | no       |         |             |

- `id`: Article ID from Camptocamp.
- `lang`: Language of titles and texts, one of: fr, en, de, it, es, ca, eu, sl, zh (default fr). Values: `fr`, `en`, `de`, `it`, `es`, `ca`, `eu`, `sl`, `zh`
